description: Verify the bundle is in a legal state for incremental rerun: rationale present, rerun count within limit, bundle structure intact, status consistent.

rules.failure_message: HITL2 rationale is empty or missing. The user must provide a rationale explaining what they want to change in the rerun. Return to HITL2 to collect rationale before rerunning.
rerun_count has reached the maximum of 3 rerun cycles. The rerun path is blocked. Suggest the user accept current results or start a new Deep Research.
Required bundle directories are missing. seed_topics/ and reference/ must exist. Verify bundle integrity before rerunning.
rb_status.json current_gate must be 'rerun_ready'. Use advance-status --to rerun_ready to advance.
rb_status.json next_gate must be 'seed_topics_ready'. Status may have drifted — use advance-status --to rerun_ready to set the correct value.
